questions.q: Why did Rat load everyone up with belts, swords, pistols and other gear?

Badger had ordered him to carry it all for the others
He planned to sell the weapons once the fight was over
He wanted to scare Toad into staying home and safe

Toad first, Rat next, Mole last
Rat first, Toad next, Mole last
All four marching side by side

Badger mistook Toad for a weasel at the trap-door above

Behind the big kitchen fireplace
Under the bed in Toad's own bedroom

Hid down in the secret passage under the pantry

Fixing the windows the weasels had broken
